final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.transref AS t, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s3) SELECT s3.t, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a - s4.m AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e DESC LIMIT 10
